sections.title: About this space
content: Nice & Easy is our comfort of room, complete with a generously sized bathroom and bed, for your convenience. Plenty natural ventilation that fills the room with fresh air, along with a beautiful local hand made ceiling.
The Easy room, also known as Room 4, is the guarantee to a refreshing and stress free time in Bali. Enjoy out social area and pool at your door or take a short walk to the beach.

sections.title: The space
content: Enjoy the cute yet small room's spaciousness and comfort, which comes with a roomy bathroom. Your stay will be enjoyable and restful, simple and refreshing due to lots of windows and nature integrated features.

✔Sleep soundly on the cozy queen-sized bed, and enjoy the flexibility of choosing between a fan and air conditioning to suit your personal preferences. With plenty of storage space for your belongings, including a dedicated area for hanging clothes, you can keep everything organized and tidy during your stay.

✔ Step outside and savor the refreshing breeze in the sitting area right next to your room. It's the perfect spot to soak up some sunshine or simply unwind with a good book. We can't wait to welcome you to our tranquil and inviting space!

sections.title: ★★LIVING AREA
content: Enjoy a leisurely afternoon with your family and friends while lounging on comfortable chairs and watching your favorite film. All of the rooms have access to the shared living area, which offers enough of space to ensure that your stay is enjoyable.
✔ Plenty of area for you to work in relaxed areas super excellent for dancing area
✔ Spacious Open concept living space with lots of natural lighting and sitting areas!

sections.title: 🏘 KITCHEN & DINING
content: The kitchen is furnished with modern cooking utensils and has a Wooden scheme. There are numerous working spaces and spacious countertops in the kitchen.
✔ Ample Counter Space with Island & High-top Seating
Best equipped kitchen you can find
Dine like royalty in the spacious dining area overlooking the backyard
✔ Dining areas for as many as 30 people

sections.title: 🏛 Parking
content: Scooter can be parked directly in the property while Cars can be accommodated in the private parking 20 meters away.

sections.title: Guest access
content: The Guests has complete access to the private room and private bathroom with personal garden without interruption or sharing of anyone else.

Our team is dedicated to making sure that your stay with us is as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. We are always available to answer any questions or help with anything you need, whether it's providing fresh towels or recommendations on the best local restaurants and attractions.

Our team is dedicated to ensuring that your stay with us is as comfortable and enjoyable as possible. From providing fresh linens and towels to answering any questions you may have, we are here to help in any way we can
You can communicate to our Co-Hosts on Airbnb, They will respond within an hour almost 24/7

sections.title: Other things to note
content: If you need to arrive early you can leave your bags and enjoy the social area. Guests coming in after 8pm will have to pay a small extra fee (100k) due to the fact that building waits for welcoming you them after their due time.
(and you can leave you luggage in-house until 8pm)
Please respect our gardens, enjoy them.

termsConditions.otherRules: If you come at night between 9 PM till 6 AM we can arrange that someone checks you in for an additional fee of 15 USD.
